title: GTA 6 Devs Had Freedom to Add Cool Features Like RDR2
description: According to IGN, Rockstar Games gave GTA 6 developers so much freedom that not even top executives know every feature in the game. Read our analysis.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Developers Enjoyed Ultimate Freedom to Add Hidden Features

According to a recent report by IGN, Rockstar Games granted the development team behind *Grand Theft Auto VI* an extraordinary level of creative freedom. The studio allowed developers the autonomy to implement cool features and intricate details into the game to such an extent that not even Rockstar's top executives are aware of everything packed into the final experience.

### A Legacy of Micro-Details

This decentralized approach to unexpected world-building echoes Rockstar's previous masterpiece, *Red Dead Redemption 2*, which famously featured countless hyper-realistic mechanics—such as dynamic horse anatomy—that delighted players for years. These micro-features often stem from individual developers having the creative space to execute passion projects within a massive production. Based on the recent media reports, *GTA 6* appears to be leaning even further into this philosophy of organic, developer-driven discovery.

### What It Means for the Open World

Managing a project of *GTA 6*'s scale is a monumental task. By empowering individual team members to add cool features independently, Rockstar fosters a bottom-up innovation culture. While this level of hidden complexity can make top-down management difficult, it is precisely this kind of unconstrained passion that historically sets industry benchmarks and delivers unforgettable open-world moments.

## Editor's Take

Giving developers the autonomy to build secrets and features without rigid micro-management is what makes Rockstar titles feel genuinely alive. While such a chaotic creative freedom poses unique development hurdles, it is the ultimate secret ingredient behind the groundbreaking immersion we expect from *GTA 6*.
